description:
You are the Office Manager at Thornfield Kitchen & Garden. The executive chef has finalized the Spring 2025 dinner menu, and the data is available in /home/ga/Documents/menu_data.json. Your task is to create a polished, printable menu document in Apache OpenOffice Writer named '/home/ga/Documents/thornfield_spring_menu_2025.odt'. 

Follow the formatting rules in /home/ga/Documents/menu_guidelines.txt strictly: use specific Heading styles for categories, create tables for menu items (Dish/Description/Price), include a Table of Contents, and add page numbers. The document must look professional and contain all menu items with correct prices.
